preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rooms_import_jobs WHERE status IN ('QUANTIFYING', 'BUILDING_OFFER')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

changeSet.sql: UPDATE rooms_import_jobs SET status = 'FAILED', failure_reason = 'error.estimateai.failed.superseded', completed_at = COALESCE(completed_at, NOW()) WHERE status IN ('QUANTIFYING', 'BUILDING_OFFER')
